findings: Hand indices and SDK skeleton handedness are correctly routed; shared grip frames mirror palm and finger directions.
0.2.17 checked reach but not approach angle, allowing a fixed contact to force an opposing wrist orientation.
Valve rim frames at left/right sides pointed fingers inward and could orient the wrist unnaturally; previous preview used the top rim instead of the production side contacts.
fixes: Reject display contact when the required palm correction exceeds 85 degrees, including stale-contact release and button alignment.
Retain ownership and physical input; do not turn the SDK hand or require a drop/regrab when the display contact is rejected.
Valve hands approach from below with fingers upward and thumbs toward the wheel; preview uses the same left/right side anchors as production.

verification.scope: Real SDK display skeleton with synthetic input and production meshes; not worn-headset ergonomic acceptance

delivery: Included in Quest 0.2.18; installed version verified. See Release-0.2.18.json.
